name: Advanced Baseline Imager Level 2 - Derived Motion Winds (Water Vapour)
description: Derives atmospheric motion vectors from clear-sky water vapour radiance tracers in ABI water vapour bands, providing wind speed, direction, pressure, and brightness temperature at each tracked feature. Like ABI-L2-DMW, winds are reported as point observations on an irregular grid.
